description: This is a unit test class for the AliasesAppender, testing its behavior when applying alias configurations in a Java-based project. It primarily verifies immutability, environment variable handling, and alias application logic.

classes.name: AliasesAppenderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AliasesAppender, verifying alias application logic, immutability, and environment variable handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the static knownAliases JsonObject before any tests run.

methods.name: initEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Sets up environment variables before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that AliasesAppender is immutable and its fields are safely copied.

methods.name: appendAliasesConfigWhenSystemEnvironmentVariableIsNotSet
methods.description: Tests that when the environment variable is not set, the config remains unchanged.

methods.name: appendAliasesConfigWhenSystemEnvironmentVariableIsEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that when the environment variable is an empty string, the config remains unchanged.

methods.name: appendAliasesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that alias application correctly modifies the configuration as expected.
